questions.question: Which starter adds the health and metrics endpoints to a Spring Boot app?
questions.explanation: spring-boot-starter-actuator brings the production-ready endpoints such as health, info and metrics.

questions.question: Which actuator endpoint is exposed over HTTP by default?
questions.explanation: Only health is exposed over HTTP by default; other endpoints must be listed in the exposure include setting.

questions.question: One custom HealthIndicator returns DOWN and all others return UP. What are the overall status and HTTP status code of /actuator/health?
questions.explanation: The worst component decides the overall status, and DOWN is reported with HTTP status 503.

questions.question: Only health and info are listed in management.endpoints.web.exposure.include. What does GET /actuator/env return?
questions.explanation: An endpoint that is not exposed over HTTP is not mapped, so the request gets 404.

questions.question: A team sets management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=* on a public server. What is the problem?
options: Sensitive endpoints such as env and heapdump become reachable
questions.explanation: The star opens every endpoint, including ones that reveal settings and memory, so list only what you need and protect it.
